STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: autovcoder_069337.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: autovcoder_069337.v · Open raw
module autovcoder_069337 (
    output [3:0] SF_D,
    output LCD_E,
    output LCD_RS,
    output LCD_RW,
    input clock_in,
    input sw1,
    input sw0
    //output [7:0] s3
);
  parameter clock_mode = 2;

  reg [24:0] counter = 25'b0;
  always @(posedge clock_in) counter <= counter + 1;
  wire clock;
  assign clock = counter[clock_mode];

  wire [7:0] w1, w2, w3, w4, w5, w6;
  assign w1 = 8'd215;
  assign w2 = 8'd2;
  assign w3 = 8'd148;
  assign w4 = 8'd39;
  assign w5 = 8'd1;
  assign w6 = 8'd54;

  reg [2:0] signal = {3'b100};

  always @(negedge clock) signal <= {1'b0, signal[2:1]};

  wire [7:0] s0, s1, s2, s3;

  //////////////////////////////////////////////////////
  wire [31:0] sig1, sig2, sig3, sig4, sig5, sig6;
  reg [31:0] tsig1, tsig2, tsig3, tsig4, tsig5, tsig6;
  always @(posedge sig6[31]) begin
    tsig1 = sig1;
    tsig2 = sig2;
    tsig3 = sig3;
    tsig4 = sig4;
    tsig5 = sig5;
    tsig6 = sig6;
  end

  //////////////////////////////////////////////////////

  berlekamp_messey b1 (
      .S1(w1),
      .S2(w2),
      .S3(w3),
      .S4(w4),
      .S5(w5),
      .S6(w6),
      .clock(clock),
      .signal(signal[0]),
      .w0(s0),
      .w1(s1),
      .w2(s2),
      .w3(s3),
      .sig1(sig1),
      .sig2(sig2),
      .sig3(sig3),
      .sig4(sig4),
      .sig5(sig5),
      .sig6(sig6)
  );
  //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
  reg [31:0] data1, data2;
  always @(*) begin
    case ({
      sw1, sw0
    })
      2'd0: begin
        data1 = tsig1;
        data2 = tsig2;
      end
      2'd1: begin
        data1 = tsig3;
        data2 = tsig4;
      end
      2'd2: begin
        data1 = tsig5;
        data2 = tsig6;
      end
      default: begin
        data1 = 32'b1;
        data2 = {s3, s2, s1, s0};
      end
    endcase
  end

  LCD_hexadecimal #(
      .no_of_hex_char(16),
      .delay_rate(10)
  ) LCD1 (
      .SF_D  (SF_D),
      .LCD_E (LCD_E),
      .LCD_RS(LCD_RS),
      .LCD_RW(LCD_RW),
      .data  ({data1, data2}),
      .clock (clock_in)
  );
endmodule
